Definition
[almost maximum curvature points] Source: cao-zhu 1. Definition 4.3.1\group Cao–Zhu Limiting Singularity Models We say that $\{ (x_k,t_k) \in M\times [0,T) \} $, $k=1, 2, \ldots $, is a sequence of (almost) maximum points\index{(almost) maximum points} if there exist positive constants $c_1$ and $\alpha \in (0,1]$ such that \[ |Rm(x_k,t_k)|\geq c_1 K_{\max }(t), \quad t\in [t_k-\frac{\alpha }{K_{\max }(t_k)},t_k] \] for all $k$.
